caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate goblet or chalice rendered in graphite pencil on a light, off-white background. The goblet has a wide, rounded bowl with a thick rim and a decorative band featuring a floral or scroll motif just below the edge. The body of the goblet is adorned with an embossed, oval-shaped pattern arranged vertically around its circumference. The gulp transitions into a stem that is narrower and smooth, leading to a round, broad base that also features some subtle decorative etching. The shading and tonal work on the goblet gives it a metallic appearance, with highlights and reflections suggesting it is made of a reflective material like silver. The drawing is composed centrally, with the goblet occupying most of the image space and the artist's signature "G. Capelli" visible on the lower right corner. There are no other objects or details in the composition.
title: Silver Waste Bowl
